events.title: Halloween weekend in the French Quarter
events.proximity: Direct Market Proximity (1200 Block N. Peters)
events.notes: Halloween is a Saturday. Rough estimate (nobody counts Halloween crowds): hotels were about 90% full over Halloween weekend 2025 (New Orleans & Company, via Fox 8). With about 26,000 downtown hotel rooms, that's roughly 45,000 hotel guests downtown, plus locals out in costume. Mostly the same visitors both days, so the total is the Saturday peak. Halloween New Orleans events: Lazarus Ball Fri 7–10 PM (The Barnett); party Sat 10 PM–3 AM (The Fillmore); Tea Dance and second line Sun Nov 1. Market estimate: A crowd spread across the whole Quarter, so it gets an estimate rather than 100%: about half are locals and day-trippers, and 1 in 5 of them walk through the sheds (about 2,000 Friday and 3,000 Saturday). Halloween's hotel guests are in the Free-range tourists line, which is about 410 higher than usual Friday and 990 higher Saturday because of them. Together, Halloween brings roughly 2,400 Friday and 4,000 Saturday to the market.
